items.name: Sustentra
highlights: Contributed to Python document workflows connecting AWS S3, Textract OCR, and OpenAI extraction with schema-backed JSON and field-level source context.
Worked with engineering and ESG/audit collaborators to turn review requirements into versioned schemas, validation checks, and traceable evidence flows.
Helped develop a seven-stage Streamlit auditor prototype; several stages use prepared fixtures rather than fully connected live services.
Historical work records cite 40+ documents and a 170+ test suite; the prototype was presented to 10+ audit-industry and client representatives.

items.name: GigaCloud Technology

Built package-geometry and carrier-threshold features and compared UPS/FedEx measurement stages using statistical analysis.
Shared packaging and risk-identification recommendations; no realized savings are attributed to the analysis.
